bo.perry._: By the time Oskar Perry reached S-F2, the war was 3 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Oskar Perry fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Oskar Perry had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel Red crossed it, Oskar Perry fired. Wendel Red was badly wounded.
mightbe_chris: Tobias "Smokes" Chris, a railway porter from Port Abel, was sent forward on Day 4 to fill a gap in R-F3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Tobias "Smokes" Chris saw Albin "Tin" Shoes freeze up on the fire step at Saint-Ash crossroads. Smokes said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

Tobias "Smokes" Chris crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F11 holds again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Smokes" Chris. Tobias "Smokes" Chris read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
thervvival_: Viktor Thervvival, a farmhand from Lindenbruck, was sent forward on Day 3 to fill a gap in S-F4. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. Viktor Thervvival transferred to the runners. The men in S-F4 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.
The rain did not stop once. Viktor Thervvival slept standing up, wedged against the wall of S-F4, and dreamt of dry socks.
Splinters from a shell rained down on S-F4. Viktor Thervvival took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step.
Viktor Thervvival no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
